description: Read the outstanding totals for the payer account this member belongs to, from the source's fixed other-payer branch. These are account-level figures labeled source.scope=payer-account-aggregate: they are not this member's personal debt, and the source attributes neither an individual debtor nor a currency. Do not present them as what the member owes. For how this member's own charges are paid, use maccabi_account with section=payment_methods. No payment is made.
name: maccabi_payer_account_totals
